Return of T Mac took the upset anyway, getting 14.7 from trade pickup Bijan Robinson while Courtland Sutton, the free agent add on the other side, put up 6. Garrett Wilson, the winners' other trade add, flopped too, and Woody Marks, Drake London and Amon-Ra St. Brown are all now listed Questionable.

All You Need Is Love beat Bo Girds 121.63 to 110.27 in an upset, and it was a season high for the winners. The losers' recent add Devaughn Vele chipped in 13.9, while their Houston Texans defense contributed 0.05. Aaron Jones Sr. is now listed Questionable, and the winners still got there with Joe Burrow outscoring the margin on his own.

blurbs.motw: Return of T Mac knocked off first-place Lil Fridge 101.61 to 89.77 in an upset. The real story sat on the bench: Caleb Williams scored 22.12 there while Bryce Young started, and that swap flips the result. Brutal lineup call. Bryce Young finished dead last among started quarterbacks with 7.42. On the other side, Bijan Robinson, a recent add by trade, managed 14.7 and still outscored the margin on his own. Recent add Courtland Sutton chipped in 6 for the leaders, and Christian McCaffrey, who put up 19, is now listed Questionable.
blurbs.game_changer: Caleb Douglas, a recent free agent add, gave Unsolicited Dak Picks 20 points on a 6.25 projection. That outscored the margin on his own as this side beat behold the lamb in an upset. The same lineup started the Baltimore Ravens defense and got -4 for it. Josh Jacobs, acquired by trade, chipped in 17.6, while Kyler Murray, a free agent add across the way, managed 13.9. Saquon Barkley, who gave the losing side 14.1, is now listed Questionable.
blurbs.awards: Tony Pollard was the Top Scorer with 35, and the new pickup came over in a week 6 trade to Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team. Unsolicited Dak Picks left Dak Prescott on the bench for an MVB 23.28 and still won behind the new pickup Caleb Douglas, the Game Changer with 20. London Cooking got 1.6 from Nico Collins, the Underperformer, and he has now missed projection 3 weeks running. Drake London and Amon-Ra St. Brown are now listed Questionable.
blurbs.position_leaders: Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team landed Tony Pollard, Tee Higgins and Bo Nix among the position leaders, and not one of them is named Amon-Ra. Pollard topped every started running back with 35, on an 86 percent carry share. All You Need Is Love got the top quarterback in Joe Burrow at 28.88, plus the top defense in the Vikings. Jaxon Smith-Njigba led the receivers with 26.8, on the biggest share of his team's targets and air yards among started WRs.
